column2: Who are you?
I'm the Cat Demon! Now, let me give you a brief introduction to this place.
Where is this?
In the beginning, there was born a continent named Bloodfall.
The Bloodfall Continent brims with energy, giving rise to many races and forms of life.

On this continent, the strong may trample countless weak underfoot at will!
And here — this is the Na Family, Yangang Fief, Siyong World, Bloodfall Continent.
And who is Neko?
Neko, an unremarkable little girl of the Na Family in Yangang City.
One day, just as Neko finished her morning cultivation,
she found that her sister Nanami, who grew up alongside her, had vanished.
On learning from the family that Nanami had gone out to train yesterday and hadn't returned, Neko was in no state to think it over,
and resolutely left the family alone to search for Nanami's trail.
And so, our story begins here…
In [V0.13], this dialogue theoretically won't unlock.
If you're updating a save from an old version, use this dialogue to unlock the later areas.

Hello? Is there a shop nearby?
Little girl, just came out from your family, did you?
Land in central Yangang City costs a fortune, so shops are usually outside the 16th Ring.
The nearest one is a chain store, the "Yangang General Store."
And you are…?

Where'd this little girl come from — going out to train alone with cultivation as slight as yours,
are you really sure that's fine? The Wildbeasts out there will eat you.
Mister, it's not nice to look down on people, you know.
Hey, who're you calling mister — you want me to——
Wait, mister, what's that in your hand?

This, this is a map,
charting a recently discovered treasure site.
Any more detailed information?

Yes, yes, I hear there's plenty of good stuff inside,
but it's quite dangerous — few come out alive.
Hand this over and you can go.

…So be it.
(Ugh, to be bested by a little girl this time — what rotten luck. How will I explain this to the family later…)

Zone 3-1 unlocked!
Um… old sir, what did you want to say?
Sometimes, fighting monsters head-on yields little.
But when you use your pickaxe cleverly,
you may achieve unexpected wonders."

But don't get greedy…
diminishing marginal returns are on full display here.
Sister!

Koko?!
Why are you here? It's dangerous.
Listen to your sister — stop fooling around and get back to the family, quickly.
No. An obedient child could never abandon her sister at a time like this.

…It's my fault for not being clear.
Actually, this expedition had Head Nabu's tacit approval.
Or rather, he deliberately arranged for me to come.
Huh, huh?

…I'll be honest — during an earlier Wildbeast hunt,
the family was ambushed by an unknown party and suffered heavy losses.

The attacker was extremely powerful.
Using his uncanny movement and speed,
he slaughtered our kin with almost effortless ease.

The head, furious, sent the family's finest elites to search,
and at last — they discovered this treasure-laden Crypt,
and spread the word!

Now, Earth-Tier cultivators from a thousand li around
have been getting word and rushing here one after another.
Yet the Crypt's master has made no move.
So that's how it is? Sounds a little scary. Then Sister, why are you…

Mm… this opponent is very cunning.
If the family rashly sent a Sky-Tier powerhouse,
it would only put them on alert.

So they quietly sent me, an inconspicuous junior,
disguised as a reckless ordinary adventurer.
And right now, I hold a trump card enough to kill them.

But there are just too many Wildbeasts below.
I can handle a few at most,
and I can't expose that trump card — so I got trapped here.
Leave it to me, Sister. Together, we'll take them all down!

No, no, it's too dangerous.
…Wait, Koko, how did you get here?
Don't tell me you took care of that elite Wildbeast up above?
I told you, don't underestimate me. Besides, if I can't even help my sister with this much, then what am I even for?

…
I see — so the little girl has grown up without my noticing…
All right, understood.
Father, Sister.

[Nabu] You're both here. Koko, Nana, you've done well this time.
[Nanami] Koko, we really rendered great service this time! The Lord's Manor actually gave such a huge reward.
Yes… the reward was far richer than I imagined.

[Nabu] Koko, is something on your mind?
[Nanami] Head, Senior, whatever Koko wants to say, she'll say herself. Don't press her…
[Nabu] So be it. After all, the little girl is eleven this year. How does it feel? About to break through to Earth-Tier, aren't you?
Yes… ever since the trip to the Crypt, I've felt it deeply — I've faintly touched that threshold.

There are two ways to reach Earth-Tier.
The first is to slowly accumulate insight until it comes naturally.
The second — a swift breakthrough through trials.
…I don't want to wait any longer. Father, Sister, I want to go to the Wildbeast Forest and seek the chance to break through.

[Nanami] Koko…
[Nabu] The Wildbeast Forest is perilous,
but since you have this adventurous heart, your father will surely support you.

The sword and armor you cobbled together from scraps in the Training Ground
are yours from now on.

And a protective talisman hiding a teleportation array.
If you meet danger, use it.

[Nanami] Head, Senior, the Wildbeast Forest is too dangerous.
Why not give Koko the Laser Gun I used before?

No. Though it would let Koko handle trouble easily,
it would also rob her of the pressure a breakthrough needs.
Father, what is a Laser Gun?

It's about time I told you these things.
They tie into a legend.

The legend of the 【Alien Clans】.
Once you break through to Earth-Tier, Koko, I'll tell you more.
Is that so… I understand. Then, wait for my good news.

Hmph, always giving your sister worry.
Do your best, little girl.
…Just like before, be sure to come back safe and sound.

Father once said the outside world is dangerous and cruel.
…But I don't believe it. I want to go see farther places.

Now I've been through a brush with death,
and I understand what Father meant.

Perhaps, on the day I truly become strong,
this wish can come true.
Beyond the waterfall are mountains; what's beyond the mountains?

[A strange voice] What are you afraid of?
You must become strong! Go explore the outside world!
Life-and-death trials won't kill you — at worst you fail and wake up back in bed!

Her body grew ever more supple and nimble.
All the sediment accumulated over these days
was finally, in this moment, fully ignited!
…What happened? What did I just do?
Water Heartless · Flood, Water Heartless · Flowing Water, Water Heartless · Rain have been added to your selectable Techniques!
Koko! Are you all right? What are all these wounds?
It's a long story… I got into a fight with the Hundred Clans out there. Good thing I had that talisman.

Neko told Nabu what had happened,
including the unexpected gain from contemplating the Qingye Waterfall after being wounded.

[Nabu] Outrageous — those Hundred-Clans bastards! They deserve to die!
Merely envious of what my Na Family gained this time, they pulled such a stunt.
That Bailan isn't even Earth-Tier and has no standing in the Hundred Clans at all — "avenging him" is just a shameful excuse!
This matter… is partly my fault too. I shouldn't have provoked the powerful Hundred Clans and brought trouble to the family.

Koko, this isn't your fault.
Don't go out alone for a while; I'll send people to protect you. [Neko] I'm fine. Father, you said it yourself — only dangerous places hold opportunity.
The strength I have now is precisely thanks to this life-and-death crisis.
(The lore of the Alien Clans is omitted here) What a captivating world—
…It's also time to send you into the Family Secret Realm to temper yourself. Mind you, the standard for entering the Na Family Secret Realm is reaching mid Earth-Tier.
Huh, the Family Secret Realm?
Hmph~ now you know how formidable I am?

Mercy, mercy——
I'm just a "Spirit" born of the Secret Realm,
I've got no assets or resources at all…
Huh, in a core area like this, you should have some of the Secret Realm's privileges, right?

Ah, right, right!
I can help you adjust the Secret Realm's spirit-array power!
That way you can gain more combat insight!
How high is the spirit-array power set right now?
Raise the spirit-array power to the current cap (ノ▼Д▼)ノ
…Senior, and you are…?

Heh, you don't recognize me yet?
True — it's been several thousand years since I fell.
Back then, I followed the Lord of Yangang City and earned merit in battle,
founding the Na Family within Yangang City.
I never imagined the family would come this far.
